```{r}
#| label: setup-env
#| include: false

library(here)
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)

# Load pre-calculated inline quarterly report variables
vars_path <- here::here("data", "report_vars.rds")

if (file.exists(vars_path)) {
  report_vars <- readRDS(vars_path)
} else {
  # Fallback structure if script hasn't populated data yet
  report_vars <- list(
    current_quarter      = "Latest Available",
    top_lq_industry      = "Automotive & Advanced Manufacturing",
    top_lq_score         = "N/A",
    total_qcew_emp       = "N/A",
    avg_weekly_wage      = "N/A",
    yoy_wage_growth      = "N/A"
  )
}
```

:::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon="false"}
## Executive Summary (`r report_vars$current_quarter`)

- **Total Covered Payrolls:** Total QCEW employment across the OWL Corridor stood at **`r report_vars$total_qcew_emp`** jobs.

- **Wage Dynamics:** Average weekly wages across all covered industries reached **\$`r report_vars$avg_weekly_wage`**, representing a year-over-year change of **`r report_vars$yoy_wage_growth`%**.

- **Regional Specialization:** The strongest industry concentration across the corridor remains **`r report_vars$top_lq_industry`** with a Location Quotient of **`r report_vars$top_lq_score`**.

  :::

## 1. Industry Sector Employment Trajectories

The Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages (QCEW) provides near-universe coverage of employment and payrolls, revealing structural shifts across key NAICS industry sectors.

![Quarterly Employment Levels by Key Industry Sector](`r here::here("plots", "quarterly_qcew_employment.png")`){#fig-qcew-emp fig-align="center" width=100%}

## 2. Average Weekly Wage Growth Dynamics

Weekly wage trends highlight purchasing power changes and labor cost structures across county jurisdictions and major industry clusters.

![Average Weekly Wages and Year-over-Year Growth Trajectories](`r here::here("plots", "quarterly_wage_growth.png")`){#fig-wages fig-align="center" width=100%}

## 3. Industrial Concentration & Location Quotients (LQs)

Location Quotients measure regional industry concentration relative to national benchmarks ($LQ > 1.0$ indicates export-oriented regional specialization).

![Location Quotients for Key Industry Sectors Across OWL Corridor Counties](`r here::here("plots", "quarterly_industry_lq.png")`){#fig-lq fig-align="center" width=100%}
